trigger.observation: The generated bootstrap retained a successful construction-only 'ls -la .pipreqs' probe and failed before Official Pyright because that path was absent in the fresh checkout.

root_cause: compile_repo2run_open_program imported the shared structured command analyzer but did not use it to remove commands proven to be read-only observations. The adapter therefore converted construction probes into deployment requirements.
scientific_treatment: Do not rewrite or replace any artifact in the running affected study.
Do not count a terminal caused by a retained read-only probe as a Repo2Run Observation, Constraint, or Operation failure.
Classify each demonstrably affected episode as adapter/protocol censored in the affected-study adjudication.
Use the corrected compiler only in a separately recorded future run.

future_fix.implementation: Run each mapped successful command through analyze_successful_command and drop it only when the existing parser proves the whole command is observational. Preserve compound or unknown commands under the existing open-program behavior.

claim_boundary: This record identifies an adapter validity defect. It is not evidence that Repo2Run would pass the affected case after correction and does not change any EnvSolve-Pro A/B outcome.
